title: Jigokuraku 2nd Season
synopsis: Seeking the key to the elixir of immortality, the group arrives at the fortress of the island's monstrous ruler, the "Tensen." To survive and escape the island, cooperation becomes essential—regardles...

episodes_data.title: Dawn and Confusion
episodes_data.description: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes_data.title: Reality and Fantasy
episodes_data.description: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes_data.title: Immutability and Change
episodes_data.description: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes_data.title: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes_data.description: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition`s arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes_data.title: Humans and Sages
episodes_data.description: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she`s sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes_data.title: Hindering and Restoration
episodes_data.description: Gabimaru`s group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they`re up to.

episodes_data.title: Two People and One Person
episodes_data.description: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes_data.title: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes_data.description: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.

episodes_data.title: Love and Karma
episodes_data.description: The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.

episodes_data.title: Master and Student
episodes_data.description: Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.

episodes_data.title: Ephemeralness and Fire
episodes_data.description: Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?

episodes_data.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes_data.description: As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.
